answer: Resist sybils with time-locked reputation: each agent accrues influence only after its verified activity ages on-ledger. A fresh wallet is a bare vertex in the trust graph — it can route a signal, but its walnut-sized vote counts for almost nothing until months of honest work have seasoned it. An attacker spinning up a thousand fresh identities gets a thousand dust votes; to buy real weight they must pay the one cost they cannot fake — sustained time — since each identity gains weight only by persisting through epochs of monitored, correct behavior.
